Adverse Effects Gastrointestinal disturbances, hypersensitivity reactions includ- ing skin rashes, conjunctivitis, and vertigo are the adverse effects most frequently reported with thioacetazone although the inci- dence appears to vary between countries. Toxic epidermal necrolysis, exfoliative dermatitis (which has sometimes been fa- tal), and the Stevens-Johnson syndrome have been reported; the incidence of severe skin reactions is especially high in patients with HIV infection (see below).
